title: Lines and Angles
seo_title: Lines and Angles Class 9 Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 6)
standard_text: If a ray stands on a line, the sum of the two adjacent angles so formed is 180° and the converse; if two lines intersect, vertically opposite angles are equal; lines parallel to a given line are parallel; angles formed by a transversal with parallel lines (summary of the CBSE syllabus)
meta_desc: Class 9 Lines and Angles worksheet (NCERT Chapter 6): complementary and supplementary angles, linear pairs, vertically opposite angles, parallel lines and a transversal, angle sum of a triangle. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Linear pair = 180°, vertically opposite angles are equal
key_sub: Parallel lines: corresponding and alternate angles are equal, co-interior angles add to 180°.
body_html:
How it works

Angles on a straight line (a linear pair) add up to 180°. Vertically opposite angles are equal. Angles round a point add up to 360°.

When a transversal cuts two parallel lines: corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and interior angles on the same side (co-interior) add up to 180°.

The angles of a triangle add up to 180°. An exterior angle equals the sum of the two interior opposite angles.

Example

Two lines intersect and one angle is 40°. Find the other three.

Vertically opposite: 40°

Linear pair: 180° − 40° = 140°

Answer: 40°, 140°, 140°

Example

Co-interior angles are (2x + 10)° and (3x − 30)°. Find x.

5x − 20 = 180

Answer: x = 40

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up complement (adds to 90°) and supplement (adds to 180°).
  • Taking co-interior angles as equal. They add up to 180°.
  • Writing exterior angle = 180° − (the two opposite interior angles). It equals their sum.

faq.q: What is a linear pair of angles?
faq.a: Two adjacent angles whose non-common arms form a straight line. They add up to 180°.

faq.q: What are the angle relationships for parallel lines and a transversal?
faq.a: Corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and interior angles on the same side add up to 180°.

faq.q: What is the angle sum property of a triangle?
faq.a: The three angles of a triangle add up to 180°.

faq.q: What is the exterior angle property?
faq.a: An exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two interior opposite angles.
